verses.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.decoded: The time will come when not one stone will be left on another in this temple; everything will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Teacher, when will this happen? What will be the sign that these things are about to take place?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.decoded: Jesus warned, 'Be careful not to be fooled, because many will come claiming to be me, saying, “I am the Messiah,” and they will say the time is near. Don’t follow them.'

verses.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.decoded: When you hear about wars and uprisings, don’t be afraid, because these things have to happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'There will be conflicts between nations and kingdoms.'

verses.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.decoded: There will be big earthquakes in many places, famines, diseases, terrifying events, and amazing signs from heaven.

verses.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.
verses.decoded: But before all this happens, you will be arrested and persecuted. You will be handed over to synagogues and prisons and brought before kings and rulers because you follow me.

verses.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.decoded: But this will give you the opportunity to testify about me.

verses.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.decoded: So decide in your hearts not to worry in advance about what you will say.

verses.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.decoded: I will give you the words and wisdom so that none of your opponents can argue against or resist you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.decoded: You will be betrayed by your own parents, brothers, relatives, and friends; and some of you will be put to death because of me.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
verses.decoded: Everyone will hate you because you belong to me.

verses.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.decoded: But not a single hair on your head will be lost.

verses.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.decoded: Stay patient and keep control of yourselves.

verses.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.decoded: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, know that its destruction is near.

verses.kjv: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.decoded: Those in Judea should run to the mountains; those inside the city should leave; and those outside should not go into the city.

verses.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: These are days of punishment so that everything written will come true.

verses.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.decoded: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and nursing mothers during those days! There will be terrible suffering and God's anger on the people.

verses.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: Many will be killed by the sword and taken captive to other nations; Jerusalem will be controlled by non-Jews until their time is complete.

verses.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.decoded: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; on earth, nations will be in trouble and confused; the seas and waves will roar loudly.

verses.kjv: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.decoded: People will be terrified and overwhelmed, watching what is happening to the world, because the forces of heaven will be shaken.

verses.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.decoded: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud, with great power and glory.

verses.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.decoded: When these things start happening, lift up your heads and be hopeful, because your salvation is near.

verses.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.decoded: He told them a story: Look at the fig tree and all the other trees.

verses.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.decoded: When they start to sprout leaves, you know for yourselves that summer is near.

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.decoded: In the same way, when you see these events happening, understand that God's kingdom is near.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: Truly, I tell you, this generation will not disappear until everything has happened.

verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.decoded: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

verses.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.decoded: Be careful not to let your hearts be weighed down by overeating, drunkenness, and the worries of life, so that the day comes unexpectedly on you.

verses.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.decoded: Because that day will come like a trap on everyone living everywhere on earth.

verses.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.decoded: So stay alert and pray constantly, so you will be considered worthy to avoid these events and to stand before the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.decoded: During the day, Jesus taught in the temple, and at night he went to stay on the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.decoded: Early every morning, all the people came to the temple to listen to him.

verses.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.decoded: The time for the Feast of Unleavened Bread, also known as the Passover, was approaching.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.decoded: The leading priests and teachers were planning how to kill Jesus because they were afraid of how the people might react.

verses.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.decoded: Then Satan took control of Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.decoded: Judas went to the chief priests and officers to discuss how he could hand Jesus over to them.

verses.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.decoded: They were pleased and agreed to pay Judas money for betraying Jesus.

verses.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.decoded: Judas agreed and looked for a chance to betray Jesus when there were no crowds around.

verses.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.decoded: The day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread arrived, the day when the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.

verses.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.decoded: Jesus sent Peter and John to prepare the Passover meal for them to eat.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.decoded: They asked Jesus, 'Where do you want us to prepare it?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'When you enter the city, a man carrying a water jar will meet you. Follow him to the house he goes into.'

verses.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.decoded: Tell the owner of the house, 'The Teacher asks, Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover with my disciples?'

verses.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.decoded: He will show you a large upstairs room that is ready. Prepare the meal there.

verses.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.decoded: They went and found everything just as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover meal.

verses.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.decoded: When the time came, Jesus sat down with the twelve apostles.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'I have eagerly wanted to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.'

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: I tell you, I will not eat this again until it is fulfilled in God's kingdom.

verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
verses.decoded: He took the cup, gave thanks, and said, 'Take this and share it among yourselves.'

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
verses.decoded: I tell you, I will not drink wine again until God's kingdom comes.

verses.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.decoded: He took bread, gave thanks, broke it, and gave it to them, saying, 'This is my body given for you; do this to remember me.'

verses.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.decoded: After supper, he did the same with the cup, saying, 'This cup is the new covenant in my blood, poured out for you.'

verses.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
verses.decoded: But look, the one who will betray me is here, sharing this meal with me.

verses.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.decoded: The Son of Man will go as planned, but terrible punishment awaits the one who betrays him!

verses.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.decoded: They started asking each other which one of them would do this.

verses.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.decoded: They began arguing about which of them was the greatest.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'The rulers of the nations lord it over their people, and those in authority are called benefactors.'

verses.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.decoded: But you should not be like that. The greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the leader like one who serves.

verses.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.decoded: Who is greater: the one who sits at the table or the one who serves? Isn't it the one who sits? But I am among you as one who serves.

verses.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.decoded: You are the ones who have stayed with me during my trials.

verses.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
verses.decoded: I am giving you a kingdom, just as my Father gave me one.

verses.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: So that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to test all of you like wheat being sifted.'

verses.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.decoded: But I have prayed for you, that your faith will not fail. And when you turn back, help strengthen your brothers.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.decoded: Peter answered, 'Lord, I am ready to go with you, even if it means going to prison or dying.'

verses.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them, 'When I sent you out without money, bag, or extra shoes, did you lack anything?' They answered, 'No, nothing.'

verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.decoded: But now Jesus told them, 'If you have a money pouch, take it, and also your bag. If you don’t have a sword, sell your coat and buy one.'

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'This scripture must be fulfilled in me: He was counted among criminals. Everything about me must be completed.'

verses.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Lord, here are two swords.' Jesus replied, 'That is enough.'

verses.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.decoded: Jesus left and went to the Mount of Olives, as he usually did, and the disciples followed him.

verses.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.decoded: When he arrived, he told them, 'Pray that you won’t be tempted.'

verses.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.decoded: He moved about a stone’s throw away from them, knelt down, and prayed.

verses.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
verses.decoded: He prayed, 'Father, if you are willing, take this suffering away from me. But not my will, only yours be done.'

verses.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.decoded: An angel came from heaven and gave him strength.

verses.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.decoded: In great anguish, he prayed even harder, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

verses.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.decoded: When he finished praying and returned to his disciples, he found them sleeping because they were so sad.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.decoded: He said to them, "Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray so you won’t fall into temptation."

verses.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
verses.decoded: While he was still speaking, a crowd arrived, and Judas, one of the twelve disciples, came ahead of them and approached Jesus to greet him with a kiss.

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"

verses.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.decoded: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and asked, "Lord, should we fight with swords?"

verses.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.decoded: One of them struck the high priest’s servant and cut off his right ear.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, "Stop here," and then he touched the man’s ear and healed him.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to the chief priests, temple guards, and elders who came for him, "Are you coming to arrest me like a thief, with swords and clubs?"

verses.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.decoded: When I was with you every day in the temple, you didn’t try to arrest me, but now is your time—the time when darkness has power.

verses.kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.
verses.decoded: They arrested Jesus and took him to the high priest’s house. Peter followed from a distance.

verses.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.decoded: They lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together. Peter sat down among them.

verses.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.decoded: A servant girl saw Peter sitting by the fire, looked closely at him, and said, "This man was with Jesus too."

verses.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.decoded: Peter denied it, saying, "Woman, I don’t know him."

verses.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
verses.decoded: After a short time, another person saw Peter and said, "You are one of Jesus’ followers too." Peter replied, "No, I’m not."

verses.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.decoded: About an hour later, someone else insisted, "Surely this man was with Jesus, because he is a Galilean."

verses.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.decoded: Peter said, "I don’t know what you’re talking about." Right then, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.decoded: Jesus turned and looked directly at Peter. At that moment, Peter remembered what Jesus had told him—that before the rooster crowed, he would deny knowing Jesus three times.

verses.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.decoded: Peter left and cried deeply and with great sorrow.

verses.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
verses.decoded: The men guarding Jesus made fun of him and struck him.

verses.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.decoded: After blindfolding Jesus, they hit him in the face and challenged him, saying, 'Tell us who hit you.'

verses.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.decoded: They said many other insulting and disrespectful things about him.

verses.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.decoded: At daybreak, the elders, chief priests, and teachers of the law gathered and brought Jesus before their council, saying,

verses.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Are you the Messiah?' Jesus replied, 'If I tell you, you won’t believe me.'

verses.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
verses.decoded: And if I ask you, you won’t answer me or set me free.

verses.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
verses.decoded: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at God’s right hand, in a place of power.

verses.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.decoded: They all asked, 'So you are the Son of God?' Jesus answered, 'You say that I am.'

verses.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Why do we need any more evidence? We heard it directly from him.'

verses.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.decoded: The entire crowd stood up and took Jesus to Pilate.

verses.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.decoded: They started accusing him, saying, 'We found this man misleading the nation, telling people not to pay taxes to Caesar, and claiming to be the Messiah, a king.'

verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
verses.decoded: Pilate asked Jesus, 'Are you the King of the Jews?' Jesus replied, 'You say so.'

verses.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.decoded: Pilate told the chief priests and the crowd, 'I find no reason to charge this man with a crime.'

verses.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.decoded: But they became more aggressive, saying, 'He is causing trouble among the people by teaching everywhere in Judea, starting from Galilee to here.'

verses.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.decoded: When Pilate heard that Jesus was from Galilee, he asked if he was a Galilean.

verses.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.decoded: When Pilate learned Jesus was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem then.

verses.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.decoded: When Herod saw Jesus, he was very happy because he had wanted to see him for a long time, having heard many things about him, and hoped to see him perform a miracle.

verses.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.decoded: Herod asked Jesus many questions, but Jesus did not answer him.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.decoded: Meanwhile, the chief priests and teachers of the law stood there and strongly accused Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.decoded: Herod and his soldiers treated Jesus with contempt, mocked him, dressed him in a fancy robe, and then sent him back to Pilate.

verses.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.decoded: That same day, Pilate and Herod became friendly with each other; before this, they had been enemies.

verses.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.decoded: Pilate gathered the chief priests, leaders, and the crowd together.

verses.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'You brought this man to me as someone who misleads the people, but after questioning him in your presence, I have found no guilt in him related to your accusations.'

verses.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.decoded: Not even Herod found him guilty; I sent you to him, and he did nothing deserving death.

verses.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
verses.decoded: So I will punish him and then let him go.

verses.kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.decoded: (Because it was required that he release one prisoner to them during the festival.)

verses.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.decoded: But the crowd shouted all at once, 'Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!'

verses.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.decoded: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for leading a rebellion in the city and for murder.)

verses.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.decoded: So Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, spoke to the crowd again.

verses.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
verses.decoded: But they shouted, 'Crucify him! Crucify him!'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
verses.decoded: Pilate asked them a third time, 'What wrong has he done? I find no reason to put him to death. I will punish him and then release him.'

verses.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.decoded: But they kept shouting loudly, demanding that Jesus be crucified. Their voices, along with those of the chief priests, won out.

verses.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.decoded: Pilate agreed that their demand should be carried out.

verses.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.decoded: He released to them the man who had been imprisoned for rebellion and murder, as they requested, but handed Jesus over to their control.

verses.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
verses.decoded: As they were taking Jesus away, they grabbed a man named Simon from Cyrene, who was coming in from the countryside, and made him carry Jesus' cross behind him.

verses.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.decoded: A large crowd followed him, including women who were crying and mourning for him.

verses.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.decoded: Jesus turned to them and said, 'Women of Jerusalem, don’t cry for me; cry for yourselves and your children.'

verses.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.decoded: Because a time is coming when people will say, 'Blessed are the women who have no children, the wombs that never gave birth, and the breasts that never nursed.'

verses.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.decoded: Then people will beg the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and the hills, 'Cover us!'

verses.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.decoded: If they treat someone this way while they are still alive and full of life, what will happen when they are dead and dry?

verses.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.decoded: Two criminals were also led out with Jesus to be executed.

verses.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.decoded: When they reached the place called Calvary (which means 'The Place of a Skull'), they crucified Jesus there, along with the two criminals—one on His right and the other on His left.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Father, forgive them, because they don’t understand what they are doing.' Meanwhile, the soldiers divided His clothes among themselves by casting lots.

verses.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.decoded: The crowd watched, and the leaders mocked Him, saying, 'He saved others; let Him save Himself if He really is the Messiah, God’s chosen one.'

verses.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.decoded: The soldiers also mocked Him by coming up and offering Him sour wine (vinegar).

verses.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.decoded: They said, 'If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself.'

verses.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.decoded: Above Him, a sign was written in Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: 'This is the King of the Jews.'

verses.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.decoded: One of the criminals hanging there insulted Him, saying, 'If you are the Messiah, save yourself and us.'

verses.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.decoded: But the other criminal rebuked him, asking, 'Don’t you fear God, since we are both being punished justly?'

verses.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.decoded: We deserve this punishment because of what we did, but this man has done nothing wrong.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.decoded: He said to Jesus, 'Lord, please remember me when you come into your kingdom.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'I assure you, today you will be with me in paradise.'

verses.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.decoded: Around noon, darkness covered the whole land until three in the afternoon.

verses.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.decoded: The sun went dark, and the curtain in the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.decoded: Jesus shouted loudly, 'Father, I entrust my spirit into your hands.' After saying this, he died.

verses.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.decoded: When the Roman officer saw what had happened, he praised God and said, 'Surely this man was innocent.'

verses.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.decoded: Everyone who had gathered to watch saw what happened, felt deep sorrow, and went away.

verses.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.decoded: All of Jesus' friends and the women who had followed him from Galilee stood at a distance watching.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
verses.decoded: There was a man named Joseph, a respected leader, who was a good and fair person.

verses.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: He had not agreed with the decision and actions of the others. He was from Arimathea, a Jewish town, and was also hoping for God's kingdom.

verses.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.decoded: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.

verses.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.decoded: He took Jesus' body down, wrapped it in linen cloth, and placed it in a new stone tomb that no one had ever been buried in before.

verses.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.decoded: That day was the day before the Sabbath, and the Sabbath was about to begin.

verses.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
verses.decoded: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed and saw the tomb and how his body was placed there.

verses.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
verses.decoded: Then they went back and prepared spices and perfumes, and rested on the Sabbath day as the law required.

verses.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
verses.decoded: Early on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they went to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared, along with some others.

verses.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
verses.decoded: They found that the stone covering the entrance to the tomb had been rolled away.

verses.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
verses.decoded: They went inside but did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
verses.decoded: While they were confused about this, two men in shining clothes suddenly stood beside them.

verses.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
verses.decoded: They were afraid and bowed their faces to the ground. The men said to them, 'Why are you looking for the living among the dead?'

verses.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
verses.decoded: He is not here; He has risen. Remember what He told you when He was still in Galilee.

verses.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
verses.decoded: He said, 'The Son of Man must be handed over to sinful people, be crucified, and rise again on the third day.'

verses.kjv: And they remembered his words,
verses.decoded: Then they remembered what He had said.

verses.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.decoded: They went back from the tomb and told these things to the eleven disciples and everyone else.

verses.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
verses.decoded: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and other women with them reported this to the apostles.

verses.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
verses.decoded: But the apostles thought their story was nonsense and did not believe them.

verses.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
verses.decoded: Then Peter got up and ran to the tomb. He bent down and saw the linen cloths lying there by themselves. He went away amazed at what had happened.

verses.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
verses.decoded: That same day, two of Jesus’ followers were walking to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
verses.decoded: They were talking about everything that had happened.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
verses.decoded: As they talked and discussed, Jesus Himself came near and began walking with them.

verses.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.decoded: But they were kept from recognizing him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.decoded: He asked them, 'What are you talking about as you walk along, looking so sad?'

verses.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.decoded: One of them, named Cleopas, replied, 'Are you the only visitor in Jerusalem who doesn’t know what has happened there recently?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.decoded: He asked, 'What things?' They answered, 'About Jesus of Nazareth, a prophet powerful in action and speech before God and all the people.'

verses.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.decoded: They said, 'How the chief priests and our leaders handed him over to be sentenced to death and crucified him.'

verses.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.decoded: We had hoped he was the one who would redeem Israel, but it’s been three days since all this happened.

verses.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.decoded: Also, some women from our group amazed us; they went to the tomb early this morning.

verses.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.decoded: But they didn’t find his body. They came back saying they had seen a vision of angels who told them he is alive.

verses.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.decoded: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just as the women said, but they did not see Jesus.

verses.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.decoded: Then he said to them, 'You are foolish and slow to believe everything the prophets have said!'

verses.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.decoded: 'Wasn’t it necessary for the Messiah to suffer these things before entering his glory?'

verses.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.decoded: Starting with Moses and all the prophets, he explained to them what the Scriptures said about himself.

verses.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.decoded: As they approached the village they were going to, he acted as if he was going farther.

verses.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.decoded: But they urged him, 'Stay with us, because it’s getting late.' So he went in to stay with them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
verses.decoded: While they were eating, he took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them.

verses.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.decoded: Then their eyes were opened, and they recognized him; but he disappeared from their sight.

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.decoded: They said to each other, 'Didn't our hearts feel on fire while he talked to us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us?'

verses.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.decoded: They immediately got up and went back to Jerusalem, where they found the eleven apostles and others gathered together.

verses.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.decoded: They reported, 'The Lord really has risen and has appeared to Simon Peter!'

verses.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.decoded: They explained what had happened on the road and how they recognized Jesus when he broke the bread.

verses.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.decoded: While they were talking, Jesus himself stood among them and said, 'Peace be with you.'

verses.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.decoded: They were frightened and confused, thinking they were seeing a ghost.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them, 'Why are you upset? Why are doubts filling your minds?'

verses.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.decoded: Look at my hands and feet; it is really me. Touch me and see, because a ghost doesn’t have flesh and bones like I do.

verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
verses.decoded: After saying this, he showed them his hands and feet.

verses.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.decoded: Though they were still amazed and unsure because of their joy, he asked them, 'Do you have anything to eat here?'

verses.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.decoded: They gave him a piece of grilled fish and some honeycomb.

verses.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.
verses.decoded: He took the food and ate it in front of them.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'These are the things I told you while I was still with you: everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms must be fulfilled.'

verses.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
verses.decoded: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.decoded: He told them, 'This is what was written: the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead on the third day.'

verses.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He said that people should be told to turn from their sins and receive forgiveness in his name, starting in Jerusalem and spreading to all nations.

verses.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.decoded: You are the ones who have seen and can testify to all this.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.decoded: Look, I am sending you what my Father promised. Stay in Jerusalem until you receive power from heaven.

verses.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.decoded: He took them to Bethany, raised his hands, and blessed them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.decoded: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

verses.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.decoded: They worshiped him and went back to Jerusalem filled with great joy.

verses.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.decoded: They stayed in the temple all the time, praising and thanking God.
